title: Conjecture on activated iterative graph normalization for maximal independent sets
statement: Let $G$ be a node-weighted graph with all node weights distinct. Let iterative graph normalization be applied with a suitable non-linear activation. **Activated IGN maximal-independent-set conjecture.** Iterative graph normalization converges to a maximal independent set of $G$. This conjecture strengthens the general convergence claim by specifying the binary limit, and the paper presents it based on experiments and theoretical evidence; it remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.07764
